title: nan
authors: Scaramuzza D.; Achtelik M.C.; Doitsidis L.; Friedrich F.; Kosmatopoulos E.; Martinelli A.; Achtelik M.W.; Chli M.; Chatzichristofis S.; Kneip L.; Gurdan D.; Heng L.; Lee G.H.; Lynen S.; Pollefeys M.; Renzaglia A.; Siegwart R.; Stumpf J.C.; Tanskanen P.; Troiani C.; Weiss S.; Meier L.
key_contribution: Presents the SFLY swarm of vision-controlled micro flying robots for autonomous navigation, 3D mapping, and surveillance in GPS-denied environments using only an onboard camera and IMU.
